reviewType: Visual judgment separate from automated rendering checks
method: Inspected the full-size current master PNG for every ID.
Inspected each 1200 by 900 browser render at 3.5 seconds, near the main action peak.
Inspected each six-pose sheet at 0, 0.8, 1.4, 3.5, 5.5 and 6.8 seconds for silhouette, contacts, seams and clipping.
Inspected each decoded 1200 by 900 H.264 frame at 3.5 seconds after the complete 24-film export.
Automated verification results were read separately and were not used as proof of artistic quality.
reviewerInvolvement: This reviewer did not author the anatomy/portrait plates or runtime. This reviewer generated and calibrated the four story plates 105232–105235; their review is self-review rather than blind independent review.
overallJudgment: Accepted for the documented restrained cinemagraph scope. The revised plates have continuous modeled volume, clearer anatomy and more coherent light than the earlier flat vector corpus. No additional blocking art repair was identified in the inspected evidence.
globalLimits: Acceptance is a subjective visual judgment, not a professional-quality certification or medical validation.
The clips are held illustrations with small local deformation and light changes. They do not provide full articulated actions, expression transitions or frame-by-frame character acting.

The six browser samples and one decoded movie frame per ID do not equal continuous playback inspection of every encoded frame. Timing, loop smoothness and artifacts between those sampled frames are outside this visual review.
Story plates are cinematic painted realism; anatomy and portraits are graphite-style raster illustrations. Neither is native vector geometry.
Generated fine texture and athletic muscle emphasis are illustrative choices; they should not be described as traced or medically validated reference.
iterationEvidence: All 24 flat vector plates were replaced with continuous-tone raster masters.
The pirate telescope/eye relationship received a targeted image edit before the final master.
Story motion regions were relocated to the actual painted landmarks and rigid contacts pinned before rendering.
Review identified that 105223 showed a lateral/dorsal foot rather than the previous medial-arch description; the parent corrected its title and notes.

items.lighting: Matte bone turns through continuous halftones into the orbit and lower jaw shadows.
items.cleanliness: Sutures and pores remain subordinate to the broad skull planes; no detached jaw edge or visible mesh seam in the sampled poses.

items.contact: Mandible and rear skull retain their ground shadow; tooth alignment stays stable at the peak.
items.encodedFrameJudgment: Encoded orbit boundaries, tooth gaps and the lower jaw contour remain readable without visible blocks.
limits: Dense generated microtexture is decorative rather than anatomical evidence.
This is a held skull study with very small movement, not an opening-and-closing jaw demonstration.
